title: Tightest Ticker Covering Needs
description:
## Task

A news ticker scrolls a string of letters. A viewer needs to see every letter of `needs` at least as many times as it appears in `needs` (so `needs = "aab"` requires two `a` and one `b`). Find the shortest contiguous piece of `ticker` that satisfies the viewer. If several pieces share the shortest length, return the one that starts earliest.

## Input

- `ticker` — a string of lowercase letters. It may be empty.
- `needs` — a string of lowercase letters. It may be empty.

## Output

The shortest qualifying substring of `ticker` (earliest start on ties). Return an empty string if `needs` is empty or no piece qualifies.

## Example

```python
tightest_ticker("xxabcaxbcx", "abc")  # returns "abc"
tightest_ticker("aab", "aaa")  # returns ""
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `ticker` ≤ 10^5
- 0 ≤ length of `needs` ≤ 10^4
signature: def tightest_ticker(ticker: str, needs: str) -> str
